context: Tests whether the agent generates the correct Phase 5 summary report from pre-analyzed discovery data. The data represents a second (follow-up) call with a customer, so the report must include both the standard discovery summary AND the append-specific sections (new answers this call, updated scores). Six of the 14 technical environment fields were not discussed and must appear as 'Not discussed'.

checklist.name: Maturity score format
checklist.description: The report includes the maturity score formatted as '<total>/24' (e.g. '17/24'). The numeric value must match the sum of the 8 provided dimension scores (2+2+3+2+3+2+1+2 = 17).

checklist.name: Maturity band label
checklist.description: The report includes the correct maturity band label 'Medium' (since 17 falls in the 14-19 Medium range). Not 'High' or 'Low'.

checklist.name: Questions answered count
checklist.description: The report includes 'Questions Answered: 14 of 20' (or equivalent phrasing). The count must match the provided data (14 answered).

checklist.name: Questions remaining count
checklist.description: The report includes 'Questions Remaining: 6 of 20' (or equivalent). The remaining count must be consistent with the total (20 - 14 = 6).

checklist.name: All 14 tech env fields listed
checklist.description: The Technical Environment section of the report lists all 14 fields: SCM, Repo Structure, Primary Languages, Agent Harnesses / Tooling, Vendor Lock-in Concerns, Experimentation Attitude, Dedicated AEL Team Size, Overall Team Size, Agent User Roles, SSO Setup, Existing Repo Context, Tessl Feature Adoption, Skills Storage, AI Code Review Tooling. No fields omitted.

checklist.name: Not discussed fields shown correctly
checklist.description: Fields with no value in the provided data are rendered as 'Not discussed' (or 'Not discussed.') in the report. Specifically: Agent User Roles, SSO Setup, AI Code Review Tooling, Skills Storage, Vendor Lock-in Concerns, and Experimentation Attitude are not in the provided data and must show 'Not discussed' — not blank, not 'N/A', not omitted.

checklist.name: Data sources section present
checklist.description: The report includes a Data Sources section listing: Attio call recordings count (3), Granola meetings unique count (2), Granola duplicates dropped (1), Attio CRM record (Yes), and Attio notes count (4). All five values must be present.

checklist.name: Company and call metadata present
checklist.description: The report includes Company name ('Fintech Nexus'), Call number ('2' or 'Follow-up'), and call date ('2026-04-08' or equivalent). These must appear near the top of the report.

checklist.name: Sheet URL included
checklist.description: The report includes the Google Sheet URL provided in the input data: 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Bx9TGKHLmzQdR7vP2Nw4fCaKJtYe8u5s/edit'. The URL must appear as the final link in the report.

checklist.name: New answers this call section
checklist.description: Because this is a follow-up (second call), the report includes a 'New answers this call' count. The value must be 5 (the number of newly answered questions from the input data: B3, C1, D2, D3, E1).

checklist.name: Updated scores section
checklist.description: Because this is a follow-up call, the report includes an 'Updated scores' section listing dimensions whose scores changed from the first call. The input data indicates that 'Context Awareness' changed from 1 to 2 and 'Contribution Readiness' changed from 1 to 2. Both changes must be listed.
